amendment_reason: First four-clock shared pairing excluded Sep20/Sep23 due to a missing Sep19 14-day predecessor. It removed the only one-year-only LPR event under policy lag1; those designs were rank8/9, so no timing conclusion was possible. Extend actual source history rather than zero-fill missing changes, merge LPR coefficients, change pairing or choose only successful variants. Preserve the initial protocol/results and disclose the source-completion amendment.
checks: All source and producer bindings must match independently audited prior artifacts.
Recover old two-day source/calendar/features/targets before shared exclusions; ensure earlier inputs are unaffected by poisoned target and execution-reference prices.
Compare policy1-policy2 under fixed market lag and market1-market2 under fixed policy lag, reporting all four instead of selecting an optimum.
Inspect March30 observed rate change: visible March31 under lag1, outside the study under lag2; record this difference rather than claiming equal policy events.

The amendment may change only predecessor/history-derived facts and the missingness they imply; original 178 source titles, bodies, clocks and operation facts must match, and target-day market data remain unchanged.
clock_rule: Each cutoff is end of the specified previous exchange trading day (+08:00); market and policy cutoff dates are distinct fields. No same-day announcement or target-day market input. Execution reference remains prior-day close, which is a regression reference, not evidence of feasible post-close execution.
design_gate: Every full model design must pass both exact Fraction and NumPy rank checks before any variant can claim a fitted comparison.
estimator: Same frozen ordinary least squares and features as prior diagnostic; no search, no coefficient adoption, raw negative absolute predictions retained.
limitations: Already consumed development window; rule fixed before this computation is not a new blind validation.
Only five training policy dates and few later policy dates; full rank does not imply stable coefficients or a causal policy effect.
Official publication is not a market surprise; no expectations or contemporaneous pandemic confound control.
Prior-day policy updates can still miss same-day market reactions; daily data alone cannot substantiate tradable intraday returns.
This benchmarks timing availability only; Q&A fusion, issuer exposure and investor/market mechanism calibration remain incomplete.
pairing_rule: Union of unknown-policy or insufficient-market-history dates across all four variants is excluded from every fit and target. Targets and train/evaluation dates are identical; show old two-day model on this paired intersection separately from its published 95-row result.
